questions.question: When Moses renewed the covenant in the land of Moab, what did he remind Israel they had seen with their own eyes?

answers.text: Everything the LORD did in Egypt
The walls of Jericho falling down
The tower of Babel going up

questions.question: Why did the LORD say Israel had no bread or wine during their forty years in the wilderness?

answers.text: So they might know He is the LORD their God
So they would be strong enough for battle
So they would long for the promised land

questions.question: When Moses renewed God's covenant with Israel, besides the people standing there, who else was it made with?

answers.text: Those who were not there that day
The people of the land of Moab

questions.question: Moses warned that people would one day explain why Israel's land was ruined. What did they say the LORD did with those who abandoned the covenant?

answers.text: Uprooted them and cast them into another land
Left them in the land to serve their enemies
Gave their land to the foreigners living there
